archetypes.name: dyn-panel-manifest
archetypes.rationale: Cursor model attribution now depends on manifest fields across static and dynamic rows.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed review dispatch and plan-review manifest rows. Verify every Cursor reviewer row that should launch on auto carries both cursor_model and resolved_model, while Codex model_role behavior is unchanged. Pay special attention to TRIVIAL and vendor-unavailable branches. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
